### `r stringr::str_to_sentence("{{group}} - {{primerset}} - {{unit}}")`

```{r}
group <- "{{group}}"
primerset <- "{{primerset}}"
unit <- "{{unit}}"
```

```{r}
data_subset <- combined %>%
  filter(
    group == "{{group}}",
    primerset == "{{primerset}}",
    unit == "{{unit}}"
  )
```


```{r}
data_subset %>%
  group_by(landgebruik, diepte) %>%
  summarize(n_shannon_not_missing = sum(!is.na(shannon))) %>%
  knitr::kable()
```


```{r}
# remove NAs
data_subset <- data_subset %>%
  filter(!is.na(shannon))

diepte_ok <- length(unique(data_subset$diepte)) > 1
```


```{r m-shannon-{{group}}-{{primerset}}-{{unit}}}
if (diepte_ok) {
  form_shannon <- formula(
  shannon ~
    log(total_count + 1)
    + landgebruik
    + diepte
    + landgebruik:diepte
    + (1 | cmon_plot_id)
  )
} else {
  form_shannon <- formula(
  shannon ~
    log(total_count + 1)
    + landgebruik
  + (1 | cmon_plot_id)
  )
}

zeroes <- min(data_subset$shannon, na.rm = TRUE) == 0

if (!zeroes) {
  cat("Fitting Gamma model")

  m_shannon <- glmmTMB(
    formula = form_shannon,
    data = data_subset,
    family = Gamma(link = "log")
  )
} else {
  cat(
    "Zeroes detected (only one taxum observed):
    Fitting zero-inflated Gamma model"
  )

  m_shannon <- glmmTMB(
    formula = form_shannon,
    ziformula = ~1,
    data = data_subset,
    family = ziGamma(link = "log")
  )
}
```


```{r m-shannon-checks-{{group}}-{{primerset}}-{{unit}}}
performance::check_model(m_shannon)
```


```{r m-shannon-summary-{{group}}-{{primerset}}-{{unit}}}
summary(m_shannon) |> print(digits = 2)
```

```{r m-shannon-anova-{{group}}-{{primerset}}-{{unit}}}
car::Anova(m_shannon) |> print(digits = 2)
```

```{r m-shannon-marginal-means-{{group}}-{{primerset}}-{{unit}}}
# Estimated marginal means per land use *within each depth layer*
emmeans_landuse_by_depth <- marginaleffects::avg_predictions(
  m_shannon,
  variables = "landgebruik",
  newdata = data_subset,
  by = c("diepte", "landgebruik"),
  type = "response"
)


# Save to CSV with automatic naming
write_csv(
  emmeans_landuse_by_depth,
  file = file.path(output_dir, glue("emmeans_shannon_landuse_by_depth_{group}_{primerset}_{unit}.csv"))
)

# print
emmeans_landuse_by_depth
```


```{r m-shannon-contrasts-{{group}}-{{primerset}}-{{unit}}}
# Compute all pairwise contrasts between land use types within each depth layer
contrasts_landuse_by_depth <- marginaleffects::comparisons(
  model = m_shannon,
  variables = "landgebruik",
  newdata = data_subset,
  type = "response",
  by = "diepte",
  contrast = "pairwise"
) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  group_by(diepte) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH")
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(
    Group,
    diepte,
    contrast,
    estimate,
    std.error,
    conf.low,
    conf.high,
    p.value,
    p_adj
  ) %>%
  arrange(diepte, p.value)

# Save to CSV with automatic naming
write_csv(
  contrasts_landuse_by_depth,
  file = file.path(output_dir, glue("contrasts_shannon_landuse_by_depth_{group}_{primerset}_{unit}.csv"))
)

# Print the results
print(contrasts_landuse_by_depth, n = Inf)

```

```{r m-shannon-preds-total-count-{{group}}-{{primerset}}-{{unit}}}
marginaleffects::plot_predictions(
  m_shannon,
  condition = c("total_count"),
  re.form = NA,
  vcov = TRUE,
  type = "response"
) +
  labs(y = "Shannon index") +
  scale_x_log10()
```

```{r m-shannon-preds-landgebruikxdiepte-{{group}}-{{primerset}}-{{unit}}}
marginaleffects::plot_predictions(
  m_shannon,
  condition = c("landgebruik", "diepte"[diepte_ok]),
  re.form = NA,
  vcov = TRUE,
  type = "response"
) +
  labs(y = "Shannon index")
```
